title: 1920'S FLOOR RUG W-66 L-128 CM
reason: Teal Chinese Art Deco style wool rug with sculpted floral sprays; collectable type but small and worn.
findings: Small wool rug with a plain teal ground and two asymmetric sprays of chrysanthemum, peony and blossom in cream, apricot, mauve and sage, with sculpted (carved) pile outlines and no border. This matches the Chinese Art Deco rug type made in the 1920s to 1940s, so the 1920s claim in the title is plausible but unverified: no label, no back view and no knot count in the photos. Size not checkable from the photos. Value is a judgement from the photos only, not price-checked.
condition: Pile worn and uneven with darker patches; the lower end has lost its fringe and finish, with the foundation exposed and ragged along part of the width; selvedges loose in places; no holes or moth damage seen but the back is not shown.
rescore_note: Small teal Chinese Art Deco style wool rug with sculpted floral sprays, a collectable type in a popular colour, but only 66 by 128 cm with worn pile and a ragged end where the fringe is lost; 1920s claim plausible but unverified.
